tabs.overviewHint: What needs attention: low stock, lots close to expiry and opened containers near their limit.
tabs.itemsHint: The materials you stock, the unit they are counted in and how they are bought.
tabs.stockHint: Quantities per location and lot. Move stock between stores and chairs, or write it off.
tabs.containersHint: Each bottle, vial or syringe on its own: opened, partly used, moved or discarded.
tabs.usageHint: Record the materials actually used on a performed procedure.
tabs.setupHint: Storage locations and the default materials of each procedure.

overview.lowHint: At or below the reorder level
overview.budEmpty: No opened container is close to its limit
overview.flow: How stock moves: an order has no effect; receiving adds stock (inventory against goods received not invoiced); the supplier bill turns that into a payable; payment happens in Accounting. Moving stock to a chair is not use — use is recorded on the performed procedure.

item.name: Item
item.emptyHint: Add the materials you stock, then enter their opening stock or receive them from a purchase order.
item.lockedHint: This item has stock: its unit, pack size and container rules can't change any more.
item.reorderHint: Owners and the front desk are notified when stock falls to this level
item.trackContainersHint: For bottles, vials and syringes that are opened and used a little at a time
item.capacityHint: Must fit a whole number of times in one pack

policyHints.general: Opened once and used little by little (composite, bonding). The rest stays in the container.
policyHints.multi_dose: Only if the label says multi-dose: opened and drawn in a clean medication preparation area, with a beyond-use date after opening.
policyHints.single_use: After the first use, whatever is left is discarded automatically and recorded as waste. It is never used for another patient.

opening.title: Opening stock
opening.hint: Stock you already hold when you start. It is recorded against the opening balance account.

stock.emptyHint: Receive a purchase order or enter opening stock from the Items tab.

movements.title: Movements
movements.hint: The latest 200 stock movements; they can't be edited.

transfer.title: Transfer
transfer.hint: Move stock between stores and chairs. A transfer is not use and has no accounting effect.
transfer.noStock: Nothing to move from this location
transfer.containersElsewhere: Items tracked by container are moved one container at a time from the Containers tab.

adjust.title: Write off / issue
adjust.hint: Damaged or expired stock, or material given out for non-clinical use.
adjust.reasonHint: At least 5 characters; kept in the audit trail

containers.intro: Each physical container has its own code. Open it before using it; what is used on a patient is recorded under Materials used.
containers.emptyHint: Containers are created when you receive an item that is tracked by container.
containers.beyondUseHint: The beyond-use date after opening, from the label or your clinic's policy
containers.discardBody: {{qty}} will be recorded as waste. This can't be undone.

po.flow: 1 Order (no stock, no accounting) → 2 Receive with lot and expiry (stock in) → 3 Enter the supplier's bill (payable) → 4 Pay it in Accounting.
po.title: Purchase orders
po.addHint: Prices are per pack, as on the supplier's price list.

receipt.title: Goods received
receipt.hint: Each receipt adds stock once. Its supplier bill clears the goods-received account.
receipt.receiveHint: Enter what actually arrived, with the lot and expiry printed on the box.
receipt.containersHint: one container is created per container size
receipt.payHint: Supplier bills are paid in Accounting.
receipt.billBody: Posts a supplier bill for {{supplier}}, for the received value:

usage.pickPatientHint: Their performed procedures are listed so you can record the materials used.
usage.recordHint: Choose the procedure, check the suggested materials and enter what was really used.
usage.noProcedures: No performed procedures for this patient
usage.allRecorded: Materials are recorded for every procedure of this patient.
usage.sourceHint: The chair cabinet or store the materials came from
usage.noTemplate: This procedure has no default materials yet; add the lines yourself (or set them in Setup).
usage.costNote: Materials are a cost of the treatment; they are not added to the patient's invoice.
usage.noOpenContainer: No opened container here — open one in the Containers tab
usage.lotAuto: Leave on first-expiry to use the oldest lot

locations.title: Storage locations
locations.hint: Stores, chair cabinets, the medication preparation area and quarantine.
locations.name: Name
locations.defaultHint: Receipts and opening stock go here unless you pick another location

locationHints.chair: Stock kept at a dental chair
locationHints.medication_prep: Clean area where multi-dose containers are opened and drawn

materials.title: Default materials per procedure
materials.hint: Suggested when recording use; the dentist confirms the real quantities.
materials.noProcedures: No procedures in the price list
materials.editHint: Quantities are in each item's counting unit. Per tooth multiplies by the teeth treated.
